preserved_peer_crosscheck.assessment: Same seam as 143, opposite side, and my direct read of 18:18 confirms OL's point precisely: the verse opens with the resumptive וְאֵ֗לֶּה בָּ֚אוּ בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֔ה וַיִּקְחוּ֙ clause, and only after that repetition does it reach וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן מָ֥ה אַתֶּ֖ם עֹשִֽׂים. The priest's challenge is real and is indeed his first line of dialogue in the scene, but it sits in the second half of the verse, behind a clause that repeats material already given in v17. A boundary cannot be anchored on a signal that arrives after the seam it is meant to justify. The task brief's characterization - 'the Hebrew signal offered sits in v18b behind the resumption, leaving only a WEB paragraph' - is exactly right, and I confirmed the WEB paragraph break at 18:18 independently in Judg_web_clean.txt: it is there, and once the Hebrew signal is disqualified it is the only thing left standing under it, which the campaign's own rules treat as insufficient on its own. Concur with the merge into 18:14-18:20.
